scope: every public output (keys not starting with '_') of the 18 units; SYS-01..04 not included

sets.dirty: synth.generate.make_scenario(730001+i, STRUCTURES[i%4], USES[i%6], 'S', dirty=True), i=0..19; outside the valid domain (injected defects), reported separately
sets.probe: targeted mutations of one clean scenario written by the implementer (see probe list); outside the generator range, reported separately

excluded: material M000002.material_life: an event time lies on a knife edge of the time rule

probes.note: no direct conversion kWh->GJ: not computed on both sides
the scenario registers kWh->GJ; the reference splits the unit text and finds it, the closed list of the specification (kWh, MWh, MJ) does not
priority: the declaration is tried before the composite factor
first row-specific entry wins; identity wins over any entry
first entry of the scenario table wins

X-13 waste_by_item on rows with basis DESIGN: ordered - installed cancels to about Q*w, so the one-bit difference between Q*(1/(1-w)) (engine) and Q/(1-w) (reference) is amplified by about 1/w; expected above 1e-9 for w <= 1e-8
the reference passes an integer input through unchanged (type int); the engine holds every number as a float, so equal values differ in type

not_expressed.what: the electricity unit of the grid factor is taken by the reference from the unit text by a split at '/'
not_expressed.reason: a text operation is not a factor of the form (not a column, not a predicate on a column, not a rational function); the specification replaces it by a closed list of three unit texts
not_expressed.consequence: equal on every generated scenario (the generator never changes the grid unit) and on the probes inside the list; differs when a scenario registers a conversion from kWh to a unit outside the list (probe grid_unit_GJ_with_registered_conversion)

not_expressed.unit: A13-05 (and any pass-through of an input)
not_expressed.what: the Python type of an integer-typed input
not_expressed.reason: the engine holds every number as a float
not_expressed.consequence: values equal, type differs (probe integer_quantities); no integer-typed quantity occurs in the generated sets

not_expressed.what: the rounding of the two-column division Q/(1-w)
not_expressed.reason: the form has only functions of one column, so the division is the product Q*(1/(1-w)); the results can differ in the last bit, and the difference ordered - installed amplifies that by about 1/w
not_expressed.consequence: largest relative difference on the generated sets: see summary max_rel (X-13 waste_by_item); above 1e-9 for waste rates of about 1e-8 and smaller (probe tiny_waste_rates). The reference value itself is ill-conditioned there (relative rounding error about 1e-16/w)

timing.note: best of 5 (flatten: best of 3), one machine, Python; reference value only. The flattening converts the whole scenario, also the parts these 18 units do not read.
